title: JEE Main 2026 (April 2nd, Shift 2) - Physics - Units and Measurements
subject: Physics

questions.q: In a screw gauge the zero of main scale reference line coincides with the fifth division of the circular scale when two studs are in contact. There are 100 divisions in circular scale and pitch of screw gauge is $0.1\text{ mm}$. When diameter of a sphere is measured, the reading of main scale is $5\text{ mm}$ and $50^{\text{th}}$ division of circular scale coincides with the reference line of main scale. The diameter of sphere is _______ mm.
questions.explain:
Least count (LC) = Pitch / No. of divisions = $0.1\text{ mm} / 100 = 0.001\text{ mm}$.
When studs are in contact, 5th division coincides. So positive zero error = $+5 \times 0.001 = +0.005\text{ mm}$.
Measured value = Main Scale Reading + (Circular Scale Reading $\times$ LC) = $5\text{ mm} + 50 \times 0.001\text{ mm} = 5.050\text{ mm}$.
True diameter = Measured Value $-$ Zero Error = $5.050 - 0.005 = 5.045\text{ mm}$.
